semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in the buying and selling of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment and provides engineering services.
summary: Hightec Systems Corporation is a distributor of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment in Japan, focusing on both front-end and back-end processes. They offer comprehensive engineering services, including relocation, customization, and refurbishment of production lines, catering to both domestic and international customers.
capabilities: Buying and selling used semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Relocation and customization of production lines
Stocking and selling used components and parts

regional_presence.Japan: The company operates as the sole distributor for overseas equipment manufacturers in Japan.
